classes.purpose: Recover the selected client engagement and advisory workspace
classes.content: Safe directory labels and stable client/engagement IDs; selected case path and manifest including client, project, objective, audience and language. Panel labels are app-only metadata; its chat handoff sends selected IDs. Subsequent agent reads of case briefs, workpapers or selected imported evidence enter model context. The adapter does not return source documents automatically.

classes.purpose: Reuse the shared client directory while keeping each product’s engagements separate
classes.content: The three products on one computer reuse the approved archive root, safe client directory, private aliases and root-bound index. Each product lists and reopens only engagements in its own product area. Search filters other product areas before ranking and limiting results; saved source links cannot open another product’s indexed content. Opening screens show projects containing work for that product, while the shared client directory remains available for new work. No automatic document-content disclosure or cross-client input selection is added. Existing sealed records and receipts remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Historical product-folder casing is resolved to the actual lowercase folder locally.

security_controls.control: One shared owner-private profile supplies the approved archive root. Product session leases remain separate. Every project has vera, lucia and clara directories. The local layout normalizer preflights projects, rejects redirected or case-colliding directories, normalizes legacy folder casing and creates missing areas without rewriting retained evidence. Readers resolve historical path casing and exact engagement IDs, reject duplicate identities and verify seals and client ownership. Shared identity remains at vera/client.json. Separate legacy archive roots are not merged automatically.
